atomic_facts.claim: Azure VPN Gateway documentation covers configuring, creating, and managing an Azure VPN gateway.
Azure VPN Gateway can create encrypted cross-premises connections to an Azure virtual network from on-premises locations.
Azure VPN Gateway can be used to send encrypted traffic between an Azure virtual network and on-premises locations over the public Internet.
